scripts.dev: node --env-file-if-exists=.env ./node_modules/concurrently/dist/bin/concurrently.js -k -n api,worker,web -c blue,yellow,green "npm run dev -w @regcheck/api" "npm run dev:worker -w @regcheck/api" "npm run dev -w @regcheck/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @regcheck/api && npm run build -w @regcheck/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @regcheck/api && npm run typecheck -w @regcheck/web
